purpose: Match the five other faction town sprites to Embercourt's camera, architectural scale, terrain-neutral footprint and centered south entrance. One design per faction, no painted ownership flags.
processing: tools/pack_faction_towns.py: alpha crop and aspect-preserving downsample, no synthetic repaint or palette adjustment.

assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: ONE original production fantasy strategy overworld town sprite, true transparent RGBA, 1024x1024.
IMAGE 1 (Embercourt/Riverwatch) is the exact CAMERA, SCALE, GROUND FOOTPRINT, ENTRANCE, LIGHTING and PAINTING-STYLE reference. IMAGE 2 supplies only the other faction's architectural identity; completely reconstruct its layout to match image 1.
MATCH IMAGE 1: elevated orthographic view looking down about 45 degrees, front facade horizontal and facing directly south/toward viewer, not corner-first isometric. Broad compact settlement, painted width about 1.28 times height. Many tightly packed small buildings and traversable courtyards with believable human-scale doors, narrow windows, fine masonry courses. Broad low front perimeter, irregular higher skyline behind it. Asymmetric interior; do not mirror the buildings. Same fine, weathered, granular late-1990s hand-painted/prerendered raster material detail as image 1; restrained highlights and upper-left daylight. Not glossy, smooth, cartoon, chunky or mobile-game icon shading.
CRITICAL ENTRANCE: one clearly readable main gateway on the EXACT horizontal centerline, at the FRONT/BOTTOM center of the settlement. Its short flat threshold is the lowest central ground contact, aligned with the front facade's footing exactly like image 1. No long bridge, extended path, stairs or pier protruding toward camera. Enough room beside the entrance for two flags drawn later by the game. Entire settlement fits the same broad five-column, three-ground-row footprint as image 1. Neutral flat structural foundations only, no terrain plinth or landscape island.
TRUE transparent background. No surrounding ground, grass, swamp, mud, reeds, snow, sand, mountains, lava, river, sea, moat, waterfall, glowing pools or reflections. Architectural greenery is allowed only where faction-specific and attached to buildings. No external cast shadow. NO FLAG, BANNER, PENNANT, HERALDRY, POLE or painted ownership marker anywhere. No people, text, labels, grid or UI. Keep complete sprite with about 8% transparent margin. Produce one town only.
FACTION SUBJECT: Mireclaw Covenant. Rebuild Duskfen as a broad, tightly packed fortified timber settlement, not a single giant tribal hut. Weathered dark wood, muted olive shingle roofs, bone/horn architectural details used sparingly at realistic scale, dense timber longhouses, irregular watchtowers, raised internal galleries and small green lanterns. Solid low stone footings and connected horizontal front timber palisade with a centered open/dark gateway and flush threshold. No stilts over water, no jutting bridge. Maintain its green-lit timber/bone identity while matching Embercourt's density and modest detail scale.
assets.accessible_description: A broad, weathered timber-and-bone town with olive roofs, narrow green lanterns, stone footings and dense stepped courtyards. Its front palisade faces south with one centered gate.
